thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert — kv-cache continuous-batching surge in prod-us-west-2. P95 latency spike + sudden GPU memory churn, multiple pods hitting CUDA OOM. Auto-remediation attempted but failing. Please ack and follow oncall runbook.
elaine: acked. I'm oncall and looking. Do we have affected customers list yet?
sam: looking at metrics now — KV cache size exploded across a subset of hosts after a rolling config push that increased batch_merge_window from 12ms -> 32ms (deployed ~00:12 UTC). Heap fragmentation and arena growth visible.
mohit: seeing repeated cudaMalloc failures in logs: "CUDA out of memory when allocating 48MB" across model-serving processes. Also high fragmentation indicators from jemalloc stats.
julia: support: one enterprise tenant (acme-corp) reported elevated tail latency and a few 5xx errors. No data loss reported.
elaine: priority = P0. Impact: degraded for some customers (chat completions slow, sometimes 503). Initiating incident channel and paging runtime team.
ops-eng: rolling back the last batch config is an option — can we hotpatch batching parameters without deploy?
sam: yes, we can push a config toggle to reduce continuous_batch.max_merge_ms and lower max_batch_tokens for the affected fleet. I'll prepare the hotfix.
mohit: recommend immediate mitigations: 1) set continuous_batch.max_merge_ms=8 2) cap max_batch_tokens=1024 3) force prefix-KV cache compaction on hosts with fragmentation > 70%. Also lower per-worker preallocated arena size via MALLOC_CONF tweaks.
elaine: runbook step 3: if CUDA OOM persists, scale down concurrency on those pods and route to warm standby region.
sam: pushing hotfix now to prod-us-west-2 canaries (2 pods) — will monitor. Patch commands: ```
# set runtime config (example)
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/configs/batching" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"max_merge_ms":8, "max_batch_tokens":1024}'
```
ops-eng: queued and hitting canaries. Metrics look better on canary within 45s — merge window back to 8ms reduced cache growth.
julia: customer acme-corp latency p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 550ms for canary traffic. Notifying customer success.
mohit: still seeing two hosts with high fragmentation and repeated malloc failures — running jemalloc purge/arena compaction: ```
echo purge > /sys/fs/jemalloc/control/purge
# or trigger runtime compaction
curl -X POST "http://host:9200/debug/kv/compaction"
```
elaine: I manually cycled one of the rogue pods (graceful drain + restart). It came back healthy and cuda errors stopped on that host.
sam: pushing the config change to the rest of the fleet now (staggered 30s intervals). Watching GPU mem and kv-cache size graph.
incident-bot: Alert update: 6 hosts affected -> 1 host still in error state.
mohit: found correlated change — a recent allocator patch toggled arena_reuse=off in the runtime (rollout 00:11 UTC). That exacerbated fragmentation when batch window increased. Recommend reverting allocator flag as part of root cause mitigation.
ops-eng: can we revert the allocator flag without full deploy? If it's a runtime arg, we can restart pods with the flag removed via daemon update.
sam: prepared a targeted rollback job to flip arena_reuse=on and restart affected pods. Scheduling now.
julia: jotting customer impact notes: Affected tenants: acme-corp (partial), beta-partner (minor). Ticket INC-4521 created.
elaine: current status: hotfix config rolled to 90% of fleet, allocator flag revert in progress, fragmentation compaction running. No new 5xx after canary.
ops-eng: compaction job completed on 95% hosts. Remaining host requires manual intervention.
mohit: manual check on host ip 10.2.14.7 shows stale GPU allocation from a hung process. I'm killing the process and forcing a restart.
elaine: process killed, pod restarted, host reported healthy. CUDA OOM errors cleared.
incident-bot: Incident state changed to: mitigated. Postmortem owner assigned: sam.
julia: assigned customer comms follow-up, will draft email and notify acme-corp.
elaine: handing off to next oncall @mira (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). Key runbook steps in case of regression: 1) revert batch_merge_window 2) flip allocator arena_reuse back on 3) run jemalloc compaction endpoint 4) scale down concurrency and shift traffic.
sam: added exact commands and metrics links to INC-4521. Also attaching graph snapshots and a short diff of the config push that triggered it.
mohit: root cause hypothesis: combination of larger continuous-batch window + allocator reuse disabled -> rapid KV cache growth + increased fragmentation -> cudaMalloc thrash. Plan: permanent fix will include safer defaults for batch_merge_window, defensive allocator settings, and an automated compaction/eviction trigger when fragmentation metric > 60%.
elaine: good. Closing channel for active mitigation. Keep thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
ops-eng: thumbs up.
incident-bot: Final update: incident moved to resolved. Link: INC-4521.
